column3: “For the sole of her foot” preserves the exact body part; “he took her” remains a distinct verb before bringing her into the ark.
“In her mouth” preserves the general body term rendered specifically “in her beak.”
The date is simply “in the six hundred and first year,” without explicitly adding Noah’s name to the year.
“In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day” states the date, rather than “by” that day.
“God spoke to Noah, saying” preserves the introductory speech formula.
“Of all flesh” preserves the body expression, and “swarm” preserves the image rendered “spread out.”
“According to their families” preserves the kinship image rendered “kind by kind.”
“To His heart” preserves the direction of speech rendered “in His heart”; “strike” preserves the action rendered “destroy.”
